meta.description: Registry for bounded admissibility-window perturbation and recursive flux-response behavior across continuation systems in Phase 3.

window_perturbation_entries.name: Window Perturbation Flux Bounds
window_perturbation_entries.purpose: Represent bounded admissibility-window perturbation and recursive flux-response behavior across continuation systems.

window_perturbation_conditions.name: window_perturbation_flux_behavior_remains_defined
window_perturbation_conditions.description: Formal support for evaluating how shifts in the admissibility window impact continuation flux.

window_perturbation_conditions.name: recursive_flux_updates_remain_admissible
window_perturbation_conditions.description: Flux variations resulting from repeated window perturbations must satisfy current process windows.

window_perturbation_conditions.name: window_boundary_instability_remains_detectable
window_perturbation_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to track and register instability triggered at window boundaries.

window_perturbation_conditions.name: epsilon_boundary_drift_does_not_force_global_flux_divergence
window_perturbation_conditions.description: Drift in the null boundary doesn't imply an unconstrained explosion of realized events.

window_perturbation_conditions.name: orientation_sensitive_flux_perturbation_remains_bounded
window_perturbation_conditions.description: The influence of frame orientation on flux response to window shifts must stay within stable limits.

window_perturbation_conditions.name: branch_pruning_preserves_required_flux_witness
window_perturbation_conditions.description: Pruning of isolated branches near perturbed boundaries must not eliminate all possible continuation flux.

window_perturbation_conditions.name: transport_flux_under_window_shift_remains_classifiable
window_perturbation_conditions.description: Nonlocal flux behavior following a window perturbation must map to registered transport classes.

window_perturbation_conditions.name: window_perturbation_instability_remains_detectable
window_perturbation_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to detect and register the breakdown of flux boundedness under perturbation.
